MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink assortment complements my wire connectors by helping insulate and seal connections, giving it a clear use alongside something I already bought.",
    "The waterproof patch tape fits my history of buying repair tapes and adhesives while offering a practical waterproof patching option I would try."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large heat shrink tubing requires a specific size need I do not currently have; an assortment is more useful when I am choosing supplies for varied repairs.",
    "Cutting wheels and pocket-hole screws assume projects or compatible tools my purchases do not establish. Likewise, hose clamps do not mean I need threaded-pipe sealant.",
    "Ten containers of super glue and a gallon of degreaser are more than I would choose without a clear job requiring that quantity."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when its purpose does not connect to a task I have shown.",
    "Buying Gorilla tape makes another repair tape plausible, but the same brand alone does not make a ten-pack of glue useful to me now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about how an item complements supplies I already have: insulating wire connectors is a stronger connection than simply being another repair product.",
    "Specific dimensions, required tools, and package quantities affect whether I would actually choose an otherwise relevant item.",
    "Several alternatives can fit the same need, but I would choose the adhesive-lined assortment first rather than also picking up ordinary heat shrink and liquid electrical tape."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical repair interests, but some assumed specific projects or quantities beyond what I currently need."
}
